items.title: Danaher (DHR) Wins FDA Clearance For Hemorrhagic Fever Test With Four Virus Detection
items.summary: Danaher (NYSE:DHR) unit Cepheid has received FDA clearance for its Xpert Hemorrhagic Fever Panel multiplex PCR test. The assay can simultaneously detect Ebola, Marburg, Lassa, and Crimean Congo hemorrhagic fever viruses from a single patient sample. The cleared panel runs on Danaher's GeneXpert system, expanding its use in high consequence infectious disease and outbreak preparedness settings.
